description:
The docs generator discovers packages by walking packages/*/data.json. tuicr-skills reads its pin from ../tuicr/data.json (one pin, one place) and solana-toolchain hardcoded its version in Nix, so neither had a data.json of its own and both were absent from https://firefly-engineering.github.io/toolbox/ while fully present in the flake.

Fix: _meta.dataFrom pointer support in the scanner (ADR 0002), a pointer data.json for tuicr-skills, solana-toolchain's pin moved into data.json (ADR 0003), and an integration test asserting the flake's and docs' package sets agree.
title: Docs: tuicr-skills and solana-toolchain missing from generated site
